in_marathi.name: Sadha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sadha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sadha signifies truth, reality and the eternal nature of the universe. It is a name that embodies the essence of balance, harmony and stability. The name Sadha is believed to bring prosperity and peace in one's life.
